findings.summary: Connections route cannot accept the required bulk policy change
findings.details: S04-T04 requires admins to bulk-select joined channels and set explicit routing and delivery policies. The rendered Connections control plane is only a static fixture surface: table checkboxes are uncontrolled with no selection state or callback, the routing/delivery/allowlist controls are uncontrolled, the Apply button has no submit handler, and no changed web file bridges to the bulkSetChannelPolicies mutation. As a result an admin cannot actually accept a policy change from the UI before the backend capability, so the task-packet acceptance is incomplete.
